messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING: GPU pool 'gpu-us-east-1a' exhausted, autoscaler not responding — sustained queue growth on inference-queue-1, >80% requests seeing >5s extra latency. Triggered at 2026-03-14T21:15:00Z
Priya (oncall): I'm on it. Confirming scope — is this hosted API or Dedicated?
Kai (sre): Seeing it for hosted API in us-east, also some Dedicated customers in the same pool reporting timeouts. HPA not scaling up — metrics adapter shows scrape backlog.
Jordan (ml-infra): Queue is growing; ML worker pods are CPU/GPU saturated. Autoscaler logs show: `metrics-server: timed out fetching custom metrics` and prometheus-adapter backlog ~120s.
Marta (support): Customer #acme reported failed jobs and 504s. Escalated ticket. Patch note: high latencies start ~20:50 UTC.
Priya (oncall): Mitigation plan: 1) Pause large-batch jobs / route heavy customers to fallback region, 2) Add temporary manual nodes to pool, 3) Investigate metrics pipeline. I'll coordinate.
Alex (eng-runtime): Rolling a manual node add now (5x a100). Command: ```bash kubectl scale nodepool gpu-us-east-1a --replicas=5 --namespace infra```. ETA ~6m.
Kai (sre): While nodes come up, reduce admission for large requests: update rate-limiter: `rls set inference-rate --scope=hosted --max-qps=60`. Pushing change.
Jordan (ml-infra): Prometheus scrape queue shows ~40k samples pending, adapter logs: `unable to handle request: handler timed out`. Looks like metrics-server or adapter pod OOMing and getting restarted. `kubectl get pods -n monitoring` shows `prom-adapter-2` CrashLoopBackOff.
Priya (oncall): Can someone check the adapter pod logs?
Jordan (ml-infra): Logs: ```ERROR: panic: runtime error: invalid memory address
goroutine 1 [running]:
main.handleRequests()\n...\n```. Also memory use at 98% on the adapter node.
Kai (sre): Immediate action: scale prom-adapter replicas to 4 and patch resource limits. Command: `kubectl -n monitoring scale deploy prom-adapter --replicas=4` and `kubectl set resources deploy prom-adapter -n monitoring --limits=memory=1Gi`. Doing now.
Marta (support): Customer comms: posting in status page that we are investigating GPU capacity/ex autoscale issue and proactively offering extended logs for impacted jobs.
Priya (oncall): Live mitigation checklist update: forced manual scale-up + rate-limit-heavy customers + restart prom-adapter with higher mem. Monitor queue. If still growing, enable fallback routing to us-west.
Alex (eng-runtime): Manual nodes joining now. Node pool healthy=+4/5. GPU utilization still high but pods scheduling onto new nodes.
Kai (sre): prom-adapter replicas up. Memory limit increased. Adapter logs now show steady heaps, no OOM yet. HPA custom metrics requests backlog draining.
Jordan (ml-infra): HPA controller now receiving metrics again. Observed a spike in desired replicas; cluster autoscaler is still throttled by quota, manually increased cluster quota to allow up to +6 nodes.
Priya (oncall): Monitoring: queue length peaked at 12000, now down to 3,200 and trending down. Latency tail from 20s->4s. No new 504s after manual scale.
Marta (support): Notifying affected customers with mitigation summary. One enterprise customer asked for SLA credit, creating internal request.
Kai (sre): Root cause hypothesis: prometheus-adapter memory regression + insufficient adapter replicas -> custom metrics pipeline lag -> HPA didn't scale in time -> queue growth -> GPU pool exhausted. Follow-ups: revert adapter change that caused regression, add alerting for adapter OOM rates, automated fallback routing earlier.
Jordan (ml-infra): Opening an infra PR to add adapter horizontalautoscaler and increase default resources. Also adding a back-pressure signal in the serving runtime to reject huge batches instead of letting them queue.
Priya (oncall): Handoff summary for night oncall: issue mitigated, queue draining, manual nodes active. Next actions for oncall: watch queue length for 2h, confirm prom-adapter stable, validate autoscaler behavior under synthetic load. If stable after 2h, we close incident.
Alex (eng-runtime): Quick check: running synthetic load test at low QPS to validate HPA response: `kubectl run loadgen --image=loadgen:1 --replicas=1 -- /bin/load -q 20 -t 600`. Will report back.
Kai (sre): Also creating incident ticket INC-2026-042 with timeline and tags: gpu-exhaustion, prometheus-adapter, hpa-delay. Assigning to Jordan+Alex for follow-ups.
Marta (support): Updated status page and sent direct messages to most-impacted customers.
Priya (oncall): I'm leaving a note in postmortem draft and handing off to Kai for overnight. Kai, you taking the rotation?
Kai (sre): Taking it. Will follow up in morning with full RCA draft. Marking this thread as on-call handoff. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident recorded: INC-2026-042. Please add timeline and logs to the incident ticket.
Priya (oncall): Thanks everyone. Closing live mitigation channel; keeping thread open for postmortem comments.
